csv_scope_of_work: The County is requesting SOQs through this RFQ #26045 for on-call architectural and engineering services to plan and design County projects of various sizes and complexities. The successful A&E firms will support all phases of programming, planning, design, permitting, and construction administration for these projects. The A&E Firm must comply with all local, state, and federal regulations and must be capable of providing all necessary materials and supervision during the entire term of the MSA. Further, the A&E firms will support the County s efforts to acquire and develop necessary land and infrastructure. This support will include the development of specific design development criteria and/or construction documents such as detailed plans and specifications for project delivery and construction

title: On-Call Architectural and Engineering Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary design services for various county building and infrastructure projects.
project_scope: On-call architectural and engineering services for County projects of various sizes and complexities in San Joaquin County. Scope includes programming, planning, design, permitting, construction administration, land acquisition support, infrastructure development support, and preparation of design criteria and construction documents including detailed plans and specifications. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
services: On-call multidisciplinary A&E services covering programming, planning, architectural design, civil and structural engineering, permitting, rehabilitation/refurbishment, construction documents, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call contract for multiple unspecified projects.
- No defined building, bridge, span, area, or structurally demanding scope.
- Includes structural engineering, but only as one discipline among many.
- Strong focus on general building services and broad county support.
- Also includes several less relevant disciplines for sbp such as MEP, landscape, geotechnical, and project management.
- According to sbp guidance, framework agreements without technical specification are low priority.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is an on-call services procurement for multiple future projects of unspecified size and complexity, so no realistic overall construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is an on-call master services type contract with multiple potential task orders and no defined project scope, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Must be capable of providing comprehensive A&E services for all phases from programming through construction administration and comply with local, state, and federal regulations. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: San Joaquin County, Stockton, California, USA. Contact: Nicole Ye. Email: lye@sjgov.org. Phone: 209-953-7790. Website: https://www.publicpurchase.com/gems/sjgov,ca/bid/bidView?bidId=212529
notes: RFQ No. 26045. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Contract duration/base period stated as 59. Pre-submittal meeting: 05/18/2026 10:00 AM PDT via Microsoft Teams; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 05/26/2026 03:00 PM PDT. This appears to be a general on-call countywide framework rather than a single defined project.
